en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new mpox case in 26-year-old man
en.dek: The patient developed a rash and fever and reported high-risk sexual contact in Hong Kong with men met through social media platforms.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a confirmed mpox case involving a 26-year-old man whose condition is stable.

The centre said the man developed a rash on his genitals, hands and face from 1 November and later had a fever. He sought treatment at Tseung Kwan O Hospital on 8 November and was admitted for isolation. Laboratory tests confirmed the presence of the monkeypox virus.

According to the patient, during the incubation period he had high-risk sexual contact in Hong Kong with men he met through social media platforms. The centre is continuing epidemiological investigations and will report the case to the World Health Organization.

Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 119 mpox cases, of which 94 were local, and all patients were men. Of the 26 cases recorded since August, all patients reported high-risk sexual behaviour during the incubation period, including sex with strangers or multiple partners and unprotected sex, and most had not been vaccinated against mpox.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查26歲男子確診猴痘個案
zh.dek: 患者出現皮疹及發燒，潛伏期內曾與透過社交平台結識的男子有高風險性接觸。
body: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗涉及26歲男子的猴痘確診個案，患者情況穩定。
中心表示，男子本月1日起生殖器官、手部及面部出現皮疹，其後發燒。他本月8日到將軍澳醫院求診，獲安排留院接受隔離治療。臨床樣本經化驗後證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。
據病人提供資料，他在潛伏期內曾在香港與其他透過社交媒體平台結識的男子有高風險性接觸。中心正繼續進行流行病學調查，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
自2022年起，本港共錄得119宗猴痘個案，其中94宗為本地個案，全部患者均為男性。8月至今錄得的26宗個案中，所有患者報稱在潛伏期內曾進行高風險性行為，包括與陌生男士或多名伴侶發生性行為及沒有佩戴安全套，大部分未曾接種猴痘疫苗。
